artworks.title: Le Villaige de Monceaulx
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Albert H. Small
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate border surrounding a gentle village scene viewed from an elevated angle. The horizon is high in the composition, with distant hills painted in soft blue tones. Large tulip flowers and bulbs are in the foreground, with a landscape of green fields, trees, and buildings leading to the village. The sky above is a blend of pale blues and soft whites. The color palette consists of earthy greens and browns complemented by the vibrant flower colors and pastel sky tones. The style resembles illuminated manuscripts, with detailed floral borders and a top heraldic element.

artworks.title: Le Villaige de Brimeu
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Albert H. Small
artworks.description: The image shows a scene framed in an ornate manner, featuring a vibrant landscape. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showcasing a wide vista extending into the background. The middle of the picture displays a horizon with rolling hills, a village, and a church steeple. In the foreground, there is a grassy knoll with some plants and a small figure holding a flag. This leads to a lively depiction of pastures with cattle and sheep. In the background, there are scattered homes and greenery. The color palette includes rich greens, soft blues, and earthy browns for a natural look, while the framing and crests have vibrant reds, golds, and blacks, giving a regal touch. The image's style features delicate brushstrokes and intricate detailing, with a focus on the ornate border and heraldic crest at the top.

artworks.title: Parisian Woman (The Effect of the Night)
artworks.medium: etching with aquatint and roulette on buff wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image displays an artwork showing a woman walking away in profile but slightly turning towards the viewer. Her hair is styled in an updo, gathered at the top of her head. She wears a dark, flowing garment resembling a long dress or coat. The background features a street scene with blurry figures and structures, hinting at a nighttime city setting. Street lamps illuminate the scene, casting a soft glow, with silhouettes of other figures and a horse-drawn carriage visible in the shadows. The image has a soft, hazy texture, creating a dreamlike quality.

artworks.title: The Mandolin Player (Mandoliniste)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dimly lit scene with several figures. In the foreground, there is an arrangement of individuals gathered around a table. The scene is shrouded in darkness with light illuminating certain faces and hands, creating a dramatic contrast. There appears to be a violin player in the center. The drawing's texture is rich, enhancing the moody and atmospheric setting. Below the main scene, there is a small illustration of a lively, dancing figure wearing a costume. The style of this drawing suggests a focus on capturing dramatic expressions and mood through light and shadow.

artworks.title: Flowers (Fleurs)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image shows several large poppy flowers with ruffled petals and broad leaves, arranged diagonally across the page. The color palette is black and white with shading to suggest depth and texture. In the composition, there is a prominent flower head near the top left corner, while a pair of buds can be seen in the center and lower left. A larger flower with extended petals is positioned closer to the bottom right.

artworks.title: Rabbits (Les Lapins)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: This is a print of two rabbits, one white and one black, both sitting and facing the right. The black rabbit is partially visible, sitting in front of the white rabbit, near the bottom left corner. Their paws are tucked in and their tall ears upright. They sit on a white surface, and the background is gray.

artworks.title: Milliners (Modistes)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: Three women are walking down a street. The first woman on the left wears a dark hat and cape. The second woman has light hair, a decorated hat, a top with long sleeves, and a dark skirt. The third woman, with light hair, wears a decorative hat, a bright orange skirt, a dark puffy top, and holds an umbrella. They walk with their bodies angled away from the viewer. In the background is a storefront with the partial word "VINS."

artworks.title: Study of a Woman (Abundance)
artworks.medium: lithograph in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person standing upright. The person's head is slightly tilted and their gaze is directed forward. The facial features are depicted with bold lines, including the eyes and nose. The hair is drawn with flowing lines that frame the face and cascade down the shoulders. The figure is draped in a flowing garment that wraps around the lower body, leaving the upper torso exposed. The left arm is extended downward, and the right arm is slightly bent at the elbow with an open hand. Small circular shapes are drawn around the hand. The background consists of sketch-like strokes creating a textured effect around the figure.

artworks.title: Hanging Clown (Pierrôt pendu)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in a doorway with her arms outstretched. She is wearing a light, translucent gown with lace trimming. Behind her is a dark interior while to her right, a man in a cap and buttoned shirt is looking towards her. Sketches of windows or doors are in the background, creating depth in the room.

artworks.title: Deluge (Inondation)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a complex scene. The image depicts a large curved structure on the right and a decorative detail on the left within a monochrome color palette. The piece focuses on contrasts and lines to create depth and detail. The artistry captures mechanical and ornamental aesthetics, exploring textures and form within a limited space.

artworks.title: Marine Algae (Algues marines)
artworks.medium: gypsograph in green on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The main object is a detailed drawing of branching coral, spanning from the upper right portion to the center of the image. A drawing of a fish is displayed to the left of the coral, shown with intricate fins and tail. Below these two objects to the right, there is a smaller sketch of a crustacean or similar aquatic creature. The color palette consists of soft, muted tones with a light beige background and subtle blue-green and brown hues for the details of the drawings. The coral stretches across the top right corner, the fish to its left, and the crustacean close to the bottom right corner of the image.

artworks.title: The Annunciation (L'Annonciation)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures. The first figure, on the left, is in a kneeling position with hands extended forward, covered in a long, flowing garment that drapes from head to floor. The second figure, on the right, stands with a forward lean, creating an arch with large, outstretched wings sprouting from its back. This figure has short, sleek hair and defined facial features, gently gazing towards a lit chalice held in its hand, as it offers it to the kneeling figure. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Cow (La Vache)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with cows grazing, a human figure sitting on the ground, thatched-roof buildings, and a sky in the background. The artwork is created using detailed line work and cross-hatching, with a monochromatic color palette in shades of sepia or brown. Branches and outlines are defined with confident strokes.

artworks.title: Dream (Rêve)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and angular shapes converging into a central, triangular form.

artworks.title: Cannes, Ile Saint Honorat
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mitchell and Nancy Steir
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level view of a landscape with tall trees on a gently sloping terrain. The trees have dense canopies and appear to be swaying in the wind. The scene has a monochromatic palette of sepia or brown hues. The foreground has sparse grass and scattered rocks, leading to a dense wooded area in the distance. In the background, there are lighter, blurry tones that indicate the sky or a distant body of water.

artworks.title: Poterne des Peupliers
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mitchell and Nancy Steir
artworks.description: The image shows a low angle view of a steep, rocky slope with two rustic buildings on top. The horizon is mostly obscured by the buildings and dense vegetation. The photograph is styled to emphasize texture and is monochromatic with sepia tones. Thick undergrowth and climbing plants fill the lower part of the scene, extending towards the buildings. The sky is bright in the background, contrasting with the darker elements below.

artworks.title: Hotel d'Argenson, rue de Grenelle 101
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mitchell and Nancy Steir
artworks.description: This is an image of a building with classical architectural design. The front of the building features symmetrical elements such as tall, arched-top windows on the ground floor with columns and pilasters. The windows are decorated with trimmings and awnings. Above them, there is a frieze and an ornate pediment with sculpted reliefs. A wrought iron balcony is in the center of the second floor. In front of the building is a garden with trees and bushes. The scene has a formal and serene setting with a manicured lawn in the foreground.

artworks.title: Hotel d'Argenson, rue de Grenelle 101
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mitchell and Nancy Steir
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an ornate building facade. The image captures a symmetrical design featuring a grand structure with tall, classical columns and intricate architectural details. The building has a central pavilion with a triangular pediment, adorned with a relief sculpture depicting figures. The pediment is supported by columns, suggesting a neoclassical influence. The second story of the building features large windows covered by awnings and a decorative wrought iron balcony railing. Below, tall windows or doors are topped with arched decorations. The sunlight casts subtle shadows, enhancing the texture and depth of the architectural ornamentation.

artworks.title: Ruins of the Church of Santo Domingo-Panama
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mitchell and Nancy Steir
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a large, ruined structure with arched openings and damaged walls. The photograph depicts the interior of an old, decaying building with brick construction. The walls are weathered and show signs of deterioration with plants growing around the base and up through the masonry. Inside, there are stacks of lumber and wooden beams propped against the walls. The top part of the structure has open holes and an absent roof. The scene is framed by an enormous arched entrance in the foreground and another at the far end.

artworks.title: Acajutla
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mitchell and Nancy Steir
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a landscape with a trench-like excavation extending into the distance. Buildings with dark, sloping roofs are aligned parallel to the trench on the left side. A tall mast with a ladder is next to the nearest building. On the right, a larger two-story structure with a covered porch supported by wooden posts is visible. Several people are present in the scene, standing near the buildings or sitting by the trench. The ground is barren, with scattered logs and rocks. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones.

artworks.title: Quezaltenango from the Crater of a Volcano
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mitchell and Nancy Steir
artworks.description: The image displays a rocky landscape with jagged rocks and gravelly terrain. The horizon is marked by clouds, casting a soft, diffuse light over the scene. The photograph focuses on details, capturing the texture and tones of the rocks clearly. The color palette includes earthy tones of brown and gray, with lighter patches where sunlight hits the stones. The sky looks hazy in the distance, enhancing the sense of elevation and vastness.

artworks.title: Plaza and Viceroy's Palace-Antigua de Guatemala
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mitchell and Nancy Steir
artworks.description: The image shows a busy market scene from an elevated point of view. The horizon is hidden by mountain slopes, enclosing the market area. A grand colonial building with arches and a decorative facade is visible in the background. The photograph is fine and detailed, with a sepia color palette. Many people are present in the market, some stationary and others in motion. More individuals are seen under canopies in the distance.

artworks.title: Acapulco
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mitchell and Nancy Steir
artworks.description: In the image, there is a view of a town on the other side of a body of water. The horizon is formed by dark hills with softer mountains in the distance. Close to the viewer, there is a rocky outcrop in the bottom left corner. The town has buildings lining the water's edge, some with sloping roofs and two white structures with steeples. The overall color scheme is sepia-toned, adding a vintage feel.

artworks.title: Interior of a Working Class Home, rue de Romainville
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mitchell and Nancy Steir
artworks.description: The image displays a richly decorated room featuring a large mirror above a fireplace mantel, a detailed clock, candelabras, and a figurine. The color palette is predominantly sepia-toned. In the foreground on the right side is a velvety armchair with intricate patterns, where clothes are laid. Below the mantel, an intricate cast iron stove is visible, and on the far side of the wall, a small round clock mounted on a shelf can be seen. The viewpoint appears to be directly in front of the fireplace and chair, providing a full view of the arrangement and floral patterned wallpaper on the wall.
